text: At its meeting held December 13, 14, and 15, 2023, City Council appointed the following members to the Sign Variance Committee for a term of office beginning December 16, 2023, and ending December 16, 2027, and until successors are appointed: - Irene Buncel - Derek Lett - Tony Tsui These new appointments fill the positions previously held by Raj Bharati, Beate Bowron, and Brian Huskins whose terms of office came to an end on December 15, 2023. City Council also appointed Janet Ross as Chair of the Sign Variance Committee for a term of office ending on March 9, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Received the letter (December 29, 2023) from the Manager, Public Appointments, on behalf of the City Clerk.
